title: Replacement reservation of untouched final seeds after Task 63 C2 protocol completion
purpose: Reserve a fresh five-seed final set only after the complete Task 63 C2 final-evaluation manifest is frozen. The earlier Task 64 C1 seeds remain preserved as superseded and are prohibited from Task 65.

seed_policy.acceptance_rule: Accept the earliest candidate indices whose derived integer is unique, is not explicitly ineligible, and has zero exact numeric-token usage hits in the eligible pre-Task64-C2 repository corpus.
seed_policy.numeric_token_definition: candidate seed delimited by non-digits or string boundaries
seed_policy.conservative_collision_policy: Any exact numeric-token occurrence in the audited eligible prior corpus rejects that candidate even if unrelated to random seeding.

prior_usage_audit.scope: Repository filesystem present at Task64 C2 execution, excluding Task64 files, virtual environments, Git internals, caches, and reserved-test paths.

exit_gates: Task63 C2 parent tag resolves and is an ancestor of current HEAD
exactly five replacement final seeds are selected
no replacement seed is a development seed
no replacement seed is a superseded Task64 C1 seed
selection is deterministic from the frozen Task64 C2 namespace
all selected replacement seeds have zero prior-usage hits
no unreadable eligible prior text files remain
no reserved test array path is opened
no training, SHAP evaluation, or LLM call occurs
Task65 remains blocked until this reservation is frozen
